subject.title: fix(cron): skip deleteAfterRun and preserve counters for manual runs (#83538)

question: Should this branch’s optional persisted `lastRunWasManual` state become the accepted cron upgrade contract after final-head live proof confirms existing stores retain scheduler-owned behavior?
rationale: The code intentionally changes persisted cron state interpretation across restart and upgrades; the correct long-term compatibility contract requires owner judgment beyond a mechanical patch review.

options.title: Accept the persisted-state contract
options.body: Require final-head live proof plus focused upgraded-store coverage, then merge the origin-based model as the canonical cron execution contract.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Keep manual-run preservation but redesign the persisted-state handling if maintainers do not want execution origin to affect reloaded scheduling semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept the persisted-state contract
